_comment: Hand-derived ground truth for eval/personas/bob-python-ml-mid.cv.txt — see eval/personas/README.md for the schema convention.
seniority_notes: One promotion (Junior Data Scientist -> Machine Learning Engineer) and ~4.25 years total by the current role's start; owns model-serving and pipeline work independently but no mentoring/leadership signal — solidly mid, not yet senior.

target_titles.notes: Current title (Machine Learning Engineer) should appear or be closely paraphrased. 'Senior' is a borderline stretch — one promotion plus ~2.5 years in the current role is thin evidence for it, so treat as acceptable-but-not-required at most; anything staff/lead/manager has zero support.

tech_stack_notes: Exactly the SKILLS line — no additional stack terms are stated anywhere else in the CV. Extracting anything beyond these six (e.g. 'pandas', 'AWS') would be inventing, not inferring.

domains.notes: Vireo Health Analytics builds hospital-readmission risk tools; 'healthcare'/'healthtech' is the actual business vertical. 'Risk prediction' and 'data analysis' describe technique/function, not a business domain — including them conflates the two categories the parse_cv prompt's own example list (fintech, proptech, telecom, ...) is ambiguous about, but they should not count as correct domains here.

work_history.years_note: Ongoing (Present) — compute dynamically as (eval run date - Mar 2024).

years_experience_note: Continuous employment, no stated gaps — compute dynamically as (eval run date - May 2021) in years.
